3673.title: Pi fresh-start session collision
3673.rootCauseOneLine: Fresh starts reuse the stable BB thread ID as the Pi persistence handle, reopening the previous transcript.
3673.proposedFix: Allocate a fresh handle on start and retain explicit handles on resume; updating five existing test files plus production code exceeds the autopilot limit.
3673.caveats: Bridge and persisted-session reproduction only; live inference and full clear-command integration were not run.
